body.name: Bounded positive-lag supergraph and micro ancestral closure
body.construction:
Define the bounded positive-lag directed supergraph on the observed window by
\[
D_{H,L}(\mathcal S)=(\mathcal W_H,E_D),
\qquad
(u,s)\to(v,t)\in E_D
\Longleftrightarrow
\bigl(u\to v\in E_{\mathcal S}^{\to},\ s,t\in\mathbb T_H,\ 1\le t-s\le L\bigr).
\]
Put
\[
W=\operatorname{PP}_{\mathcal S,L}(Y_0).
\]
For every \(A\subseteq\mathcal W_H\), its reflexive directed ancestral closure in \(D_{H,L}(\mathcal S)\) is
\[
\operatorname{An}_{D_{H,L}(\mathcal S)}(A)
=\bigl\{a\in\mathcal W_H:\text{there are }w\in A\text{ and a directed path }a\to\cdots\to w\text{ in }D_{H,L}(\mathcal S)\bigr\},
\]
where a path of length zero is allowed, so \(A\subseteq\operatorname{An}_{D_{H,L}(\mathcal S)}(A)\).
